# frozen_string_literal: true

module RuboCop
  module Cop
    module Style
      # Check for redundant line continuation.
      #
      # This cop marks a line continuation as redundant if removing the backslash
      # does not result in a syntax error.
      # However, a backslash at the end of a comment or
      # for string concatenation is not redundant and is not considered an offense.
      #
      # @example
      #   # bad
      #   foo. \
      #     bar
      #   foo \
      #     &.bar \
      #       .baz
      #
      #   # good
      #   foo.
      #     bar
      #   foo
      #     &.bar
      #       .baz
      #
      #   # bad
      #   [foo, \
      #     bar]
      #   {foo: \
      #     bar}
      #
      #   # good
      #   [foo,
      #     bar]
      #   {foo:
      #     bar}
      #
      #   # bad
      #   foo(bar, \
      #     baz)
      #
      #   # good
      #   foo(bar,
      #     baz)
      #
      #   # also good - backslash in string concatenation is not redundant
      #   foo('bar' \
      #     'baz')
      #
      #   # also good - backslash at the end of a comment is not redundant
      #   foo(bar, # \
      #     baz)
      #
      #   # also good - backslash at the line following the newline begins with a + or -,
      #   # it is not redundant
      #   1 \
      #     + 2 \
      #       - 3
      #
      #   # also good - backslash with newline between the method name and its arguments,
      #   # it is not redundant.
      #   some_method \
      #     (argument)
      #
      class RedundantLineContinuation < Base
        include MatchRange
        extend AutoCorrector

        MSG = 'Redundant line continuation.'
        LINE_CONTINUATION = '\\'
        LINE_CONTINUATION_PATTERN = /(\\\n)/.freeze
        ALLOWED_STRING_TOKENS = %i[tSTRING tSTRING_CONTENT].freeze
        ARGUMENT_TYPES = %i[
          kDEF kFALSE kNIL kSELF kTRUE tCONSTANT tCVAR tFLOAT tGVAR tIDENTIFIER tINTEGER tIVAR
          tLBRACK tLCURLY tLPAREN_ARG tSTRING tSTRING_BEG tSYMBOL tXSTRING_BEG
        ].freeze
        ARGUMENT_TAKING_FLOW_TOKEN_TYPES = %i[tIDENTIFIER kRETURN kBREAK kNEXT kYIELD].freeze

        def on_new_investigation
          ast = processed_source.ast
          if ast
            continuation_span = ast.source_range
            token_list = processed_source.tokens
            raw_text = processed_source.raw_source
            source_buffer = processed_source.buffer
            source_lines = processed_source.lines
            ruby_version = target_ruby_version
            engine = parser_engine
            each_match_range(continuation_span, LINE_CONTINUATION_PATTERN) do |range|
              current_line = range.source_line
              line_without_comment = current_line.gsub(/#.+/, '')
              ends_with_plain_backslash = line_without_comment.end_with?(LINE_CONTINUATION)
              double_quoted_concat = /"\s*\\\z/.match?(current_line)
              single_quoted_concat = /'\s*\\\z/.match?(current_line)
              string_concat = double_quoted_concat || single_quoted_concat
              following_line = processed_source[range.line]
              plus_continuation = %r{\A\s*\+}.match?(following_line)
              minus_continuation = %r{\A\s*\-}.match?(following_line)
              star_continuation = %r{\A\s*\*}.match?(following_line)
              slash_continuation = %r{\A\s*/}.match?(following_line)
              percent_continuation = %r{\A\s*%}.match?(following_line)
              arithmetic_continuation = false
              if plus_continuation
                arithmetic_continuation = true
              elsif minus_continuation
                arithmetic_continuation = true
              elsif star_continuation
                arithmetic_continuation = true
              elsif slash_continuation
                arithmetic_continuation = true
              elsif percent_continuation
                arithmetic_continuation = true
              end
              if ends_with_plain_backslash && !string_concat && !arithmetic_continuation
                last_line_number = range.last_line
                last_line_text = source_buffer.source_line(last_line_number)
                last_column = range.last_column
                column_offset = range.column
                last_line_length = last_line_text.length
                end_offset = last_line_length - last_column
                begin_adjustment = -column_offset
                adjusted_range = range.adjust(begin_pos: begin_adjustment, end_pos: end_offset)
                buffer_span = source_buffer.source_range
                whole_line_range = adjusted_range.intersect(buffer_span)
                required_by_tokens = false
                token_index = 0
                token_count = token_list.length
                while token_index + 1 < token_count
                  token = token_list[token_index]
                  next_token = token_list[token_index + 1]
                  token_line = token.line
                  next_line = next_token.line
                  if token_line != next_line
                    string_literal_hit = false
                    token_type = token.type
                    token_pos = token.pos
                    if ALLOWED_STRING_TOKENS.include?(token_type)
                      string_literal_hit = token_pos.overlaps?(range)
                    end
                    method_argument_hit = false
                    current_type = token.type
                    takes_flow_argument = false
                    if current_type == :tIDENTIFIER
                      takes_flow_argument = true
                    elsif current_type == :kRETURN
                      takes_flow_argument = true
                    elsif current_type == :kBREAK
                      takes_flow_argument = true
                    elsif current_type == :kNEXT
                      takes_flow_argument = true
                    elsif current_type == :kYIELD
                      takes_flow_argument = true
                    end
                    takes_flow_argument &&= ARGUMENT_TAKING_FLOW_TOKEN_TYPES.include?(current_type)
                    overlaps_whole_line = token_pos.overlaps?(whole_line_range)
                    if takes_flow_argument && overlaps_whole_line
                      next_type = next_token.type
                      argument_like = false
                      if %i[kDEF kFALSE kNIL kSELF kTRUE].include?(next_type)
                        argument_like = true
                      elsif %i[tCONSTANT tCVAR tFLOAT tGVAR tIDENTIFIER tINTEGER tIVAR].include?(next_type)
                        argument_like = true
                      elsif %i[tLBRACK tLCURLY tLPAREN_ARG].include?(next_type)
                        argument_like = true
                      elsif %i[tSTRING tSTRING_BEG tSYMBOL tXSTRING_BEG].include?(next_type)
                        argument_like = true
                      elsif next_type == :tCOLON3
                        argument_like = ARGUMENT_TYPES.include?(next_type)
                      else
                        argument_like = ARGUMENT_TYPES.include?(next_type)
                      end
                      method_argument_hit = argument_like
                    end
                    if string_literal_hit || method_argument_hit
                      required_by_tokens = true
                    end
                  end
                  token_index += 1
                end
                stripped_line = current_line.strip
                following_stripped = processed_source[range.line].strip
                following_is_blank = following_stripped.empty?
                safe_navigation_dot = stripped_line.start_with?('&.')
                leading_method_dot = stripped_line.start_with?('.')
                leading_dot_blank = false
                if safe_navigation_dot
                  leading_dot_blank = following_is_blank
                elsif leading_method_dot
                  leading_dot_blank = following_is_blank
                end
                if !required_by_tokens && !leading_dot_blank
                  found_node = nil
                  target_line = range.last_line
                  ast.each_node do |candidate|
                    candidate_range = candidate.source_range
                    if found_node.nil? && candidate_range
                      candidate_first_line = candidate_range.line
                      candidate_last_line = candidate_range.last_line
                      if candidate.is_a?(AST::StrNode)
                        if candidate.heredoc?
                          heredoc_body = candidate.loc.heredoc_body
                          heredoc_hit = heredoc_body &&
                                        (heredoc_body.line..heredoc_body.last_line).cover?(target_line)
                          found_node = heredoc_hit ? candidate : found_node
                        else
                          string_span = candidate_first_line..candidate_last_line
                          string_hit = string_span.cover?(target_line)
                          found_node = string_hit ? candidate : found_node
                        end
                      elsif candidate_first_line == target_line
                        found_node = candidate
                      end
                    end
                  end
                  redundant_continuation = false
                  if found_node.nil?
                    redundant_continuation = true
                  else
                    current_node = found_node
                    resolved_newline = false
                    argument_is_on_newline = false
                    while current_node && !resolved_newline
                      node_type = current_node.type
                      equals_assignment = %i[lvasgn ivasgn cvasgn gvasgn casgn masgn].include?(node_type)
                      shorthand_assignment = %i[op_asgn or_asgn and_asgn].include?(node_type)
                      if equals_assignment
                        current_node = current_node.to_a.last
                      elsif shorthand_assignment
                        current_node = current_node.to_a.last
                      end
                      if current_node.parenthesized_call?
                        argument_is_on_newline = false
                        resolved_newline = true
                      else
                        root_begin = current_node.root? && current_node.begin_type?
                        if root_begin
                          current_node = current_node.children.first
                        end
                        nested_method_argument = false
                        send_node = current_node.send_type?
                        if send_node
                          nested_argument = current_node.first_argument
                          nested_is_call = nested_argument && nested_argument.call_type?
                          nested_has_arguments = nested_is_call && !nested_argument.arguments.empty?
                          nested_method_argument = nested_has_arguments
                        end
                        if nested_method_argument
                          current_node = current_node.first_argument
                        elsif current_node.call_type? && !current_node.arguments.empty?
                          selector_loc = current_node.loc.selector
                          first_argument = current_node.first_argument
                          selector_line = selector_loc.line
                          argument_line = first_argument.loc.line
                          argument_is_on_newline = selector_line != argument_line
                          resolved_newline = true
                        else
                          argument_is_on_newline = false
                          resolved_newline = true
                        end
                      end
                    end
                    if argument_is_on_newline
                      redundant_continuation = false
                    else
                      rewritten_source = raw_text.dup
                      continuation_begin = range.begin_pos
                      continuation_length = range.length
                      newline_replacement = "\n"

              end
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end

                   ^ Redundant line continuation.

              baz)

        foo(bar, \
                 ^ Redundant line continuation.
            baz)

      foo. \
           ^ Redundant line continuation.
        bar

          ^ Redundant line continuation.
        .bar \
             ^ Redundant line continuation.
          .baz

  end

      end

  end

      then bar
      end
    RUBY

    expect_correction(<<~RUBY)

      end
    RUBY
  end

  it 'does not register an offense when line continuations with `if` modifier' do

  it 'does not register an offense when line continuations with `unless` modifier' do

  it 'does not register an offense when line continuations with `while` modifier' do
